description: The file defines the LogExtentBuilder class, which is a mutable builder pattern for creating log segments in a journaling system. It provides methods for appending entries of various data types, copying data to streams, and managing internal buffer state.

classes.name: LogExtentBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for creating log segments, supporting appending entries with various data types, resetting state, and copying data to streams.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Serializes the accumulated log entries into a byte array.

methods.name: CreateLogWriter
methods.description: Creates a new StateMachineStorageWriter associated with this builder.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal buffer and clears stored entry lengths for reuse.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Implements IDisposable to reset the builder.

methods.name: CopyToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously copies the log data to a destination stream with buffering support.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the log data synchronously to a destination stream.
